content: dsl.If/dsl.Else/dsl.OneOf in KFP v2 SDK implement conditional branching; OneOf collects mutually-exclusive outputs from If/Else branches into a single typed channel for downstream consumption (e.g. picking the winning model from a champion-vs-challenger comparison). Standard pattern for conditional model promotion: evaluate task outputs metric, dsl.If(metric > threshold) registers/promotes, else branch no-ops or logs, dsl.OneOf gathers the result.
